question: ‘In the afternoon of time’ is an autobiography of which Indian poet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harivansh Rai Bachchan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the Afternoon of Time: An Autobiography, by Harivansh Rai Bachchan.
 
• Harivansh Rai Bachchan was an Indian poet and writer of the Nayi Kavita literary movement (romantic upsurge) of early 20th-century Hindi literature. 
 
• He was also a poet of the Hindi Kavi Sammelan.
 
• He is best known for his early work Madhushala.
 
• With a literary career spanning 60 years, Bachchan wrote over 30 poems, each inundated with powerful imagery and reflective of the time's socio-political ethos.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9e1c2b35da063b36ffff22c36b498f6781ce181bf1971ca98578a5de8cfc9da.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rabindranath Tagore's Poetry Compilation book is titled 'Sanchayita.'

 
 
• Gora is a novel by Rabindranath Tagore set in the 1880s during the British Raj in Calcutta (now Kolkata).
 
• It is the fifth and longest of Tagore's twelve books in terms of writing sequence.
 
• Gigabit is a book that contains all 2,232 of Bengali polymath Rabindranath Tagore's songs. 
 
 
 
• **Sumitranandan Pant**
 
 
• He was one of the most celebrated 20th-century poets of the Hindi language and was known for the romanticism in his poems.
 
• His poems were inspired by nature, people, and beauty within.
 
• In 1960, Pant received the Sahitya Academy award.
 
• In 1968, Pant became the first Hindi poet to receive the Jnanpith Award.
 
• The Indian Government honoured him with Padma Bhushan in 1961.
 
• The original name of Munshi Premchand was Dhanpat Rai Srivastava.
 
 
 
• **Kamala Suraiyya**
 
 
• **​**Kamala Surayya, popularly known by her one-time pen name Madhavikutty and married name Kamala Das, was an Indian poet in English as well as an author in Malayalam from Kerala, India.
